nodes.label: Globe Icon (SVG)
nodes.description: A 16x16 vector pictogram depicting a wireframe globe: a circular outline overlaid with curved horizontal 'latitude' bands and curved vertical 'longitude' segments, filled in solid dark gray (#666) with no stroke. It is a minimal line-art icon in the style of default Next.js/Vercel starter assets (alongside file.svg, window.svg, etc.), apparently used in the app UI to represent a website/network/'globe' concept — e.g. an external-link or global/world affordance such as a language or site link.
